exact: entry of viral genome into host nucleus via attachment of capsid to nuclear pore complex and release of genome into nucleoplasm

definition: Viral penetration into the host nucleus where a viral capsid enters the host nuclear pore complex (NPC) but remains attached to the pore on the nuclear side. The capsid then disassembles, releasing the viral genome into the nucleoplasm.
label: entry of viral genome into host nucleus via retainment of capsid in nuclear pore complex and release of genome into nucleoplasm
